trace.question: Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal level of anti-SSB, how many of them are male?
trace.evidence: normal level of anti-centromere refers to CENTROMEA IN('-', '+-'); normal level of anti-SSB refers to SSB IN('-', '+-'); male refers to Sex = 'M'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND l.SSB IN ('-', '+-')

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND l.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
trace.answer: None of the patients with normal anti-centromere and normal anti-SSB levels are male; the count is zero.
